error_policy.note: Continue-on-error: failed sessions counted in error_rate / errors_by_kind.

metrics_policy.task_success: Failed sessions count against task_success_rate; success_rate + error_rate = 1.
metrics_policy.tokens_latency_primary: discovery/result/code means and session_ms percentiles include every attempted session; failed sessions count tokens/latency up to the failing step.
metrics_policy.tokens_latency_success_only: success_only_* fields report the same aggregates over ok sessions only (diagnostic; not the headline).
